'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis]]
***[[2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire]]
****[[Hamas]] releases 11 [[Israelis|Israeli]] [[hostage]]s, while [[Israel]] releases 33 [[Palestinian prisoners]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/11-released-israelis-include-french-german-and-argentinian-dual-nationals-qatar/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****[[Qatar]] announces an agreement between [[Israel]] and [[Hamas]] to extend the ceasefire by two days. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/qatar-announces-agreement-to-extend-truce-an-additional-two-days/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*The world's largest [[cruise ship]], ''[[Icon of the Seas]]'', is delivered to [[Royal Caribbean International]]. [https://www.businessinsider.com/icon-of-the-seas-joins-royal-caribbean-fleet-2023-11 (''BI'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Africa floods]]
**The death toll from [[flood]]s in [[Kenya]] rises to 76 as 40,000 people [[Internally displaced person|are displaced]] from their homes. [https://apnews.com/article/kenya-floods-el-nino-somalia-ethiopia-d00efc5c349873584e77ad5725d82753 (AP)]
*[[Impala Platinum mine shaft accident]]
**Eleven workers are killed and 75 others are injured at an [[Impala Platinum|Impala]] [[Platinum mining|platinum mine]] in [[Rustenburg]], [[North West (South African province)|North West]], [[South Africa]], when a [[Elevator|lift]] transporting them to the surface drops approximately {{convert|200|m|ft}}. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/28/eleven-people-killed-in-accident-at-platinum-mine-in-south-africa (Al Jazeera)]
*A [[winter storm|snowstorm]] kills at least five people in [[Ukraine]] and three people in neighbouring [[Moldova]] with hundreds of towns and villages [[power outage|losing power]]. A least ten [[State highways (Ukraine)|state highways]] are also closed with thousands of vehicles stranded in Ukraine amid the [[severe weather]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/winter-storm-causes-power-outages-road-closures-ukraine-2023-11-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A [[Judicial system of China|Chinese court]] commences [[Financial compensation|compensation]] hearings for the Chinese relatives of passengers on [[Malaysia Airlines Flight 370]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/chinese-families-missing-malaysia-mh370-plane-seek-compensation-court-2023-11-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[International Criminal Court]] Deputy Prosecutor [[Nazhat Shameem]] terminates all further investigations into crimes related to the [[2007–2008 Kenyan crisis]], following the collapse of cases against six suspects, including former and current [[President of Kenya|President]]s [[Uhuru Kenyatta]] and [[William Ruto]], due to [[Burden of proof (law)|insufficient evidence]] and [[witness tampering]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/top-icc-prosecutor-ends-further-probes-into-2010-kenya-case/7372459.html (AFP via VOA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Malagasy presidential election]]
**Two [[Madagascar People's Armed Forces|Madagascar army]] [[colonel]]s are detained and charged with inciting [[mutiny]] and threatening [[national security]] during the election, with allegations of offering bribes to army leaders to destabilize the election results that declared [[Andry Rajoelina]] the winner. [https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/rest-of-africa/madagascar-detains-two-colonels-over-election-mutiny-4448026 (AFP via ''The EastAfrican'')]
*[[Christopher Luxon]] is sworn in as the 42nd [[prime minister of New Zealand]] by [[Governor-General of New Zealand|Governor-General]] [[Cindy Kiro]]. [https://www.thedailystar.net/news/world/news/luxon-sworn-new-zealand-prime-minister-3479976 (AFP via ''The Daily Star'')]
*The [[Australian government]] [[Dismissal (employment)|dismisses]] [[Mike Pezzullo]] as Secretary of the [[Department of Home Affairs (Australia)|Department of Home Affairs]] for breaching the [[Australian Public Service|public service]] [[code of conduct]], following an investigation into Pezzullo's alleged [[Encryption|encrypted]] communications with other politicians. [https://www.newvision.co.ug/category/world/australian-civil-servant-fired-over-leaked-wh-NV_175727 (AFP via ''New Vision'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[British Antarctic Survey]] confirms that the world's largest [[iceberg]], [[A23a]], is now leaving the [[Weddell Sea]] and drifting into the [[Southern Ocean]] after being in the Weddell Sea for more than 30 years. The iceberg is expected to follow the [[Antarctic Circumpolar Current]] and continue to drift away from [[Antarctica]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/27/worlds-biggest-iceberg-moving-beyond-antarctic-waters (''The Guardian'')]
